DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。銀行のお手続きで何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with your banking procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週月曜の振込を予約しましたが、相手から金曜までに欲しいと連絡が来ました。予約日を変更できるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 先方の期限変更で予約済み振込の指定日を変えられるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I scheduled a transfer for next Monday, but the recipient contacted me asking for it by Friday. I'd like to discuss whether the scheduled date can be changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a scheduled transfer date can change because the recipient's deadline changed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約の控えを確認します。こちらには来週月曜の指定と、予約受付中の表示がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the confirmation. It specifies next Monday and shows the reservation is being accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。実行済みの控えではありません。先方には、まだ月曜の予約のままだと伝えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在は月曜の予約受付で実行済みではなく先方にも未変更と伝えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It isn't confirmation of an executed transfer. I've told the recipient it's still scheduled for Monday.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is a Monday reservation, not an executed transfer, and you told the recipient it hasn't changed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 変更できる状態か確認しましょう。追加でもう一件振り込むと、重なる可能性があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check whether it can be changed in its current state. Making another transfer could cause duplication.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい振込はまだ作っていません。今の一件をどう扱えるか聞いてからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重複する新規振込を作らず元の一件の扱いから聞きたいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't created a new transfer. I'll first ask what can be done with the existing one.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you haven't created a duplicate new transfer and want to ask about the original one first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 公式画面で現在の予約状況を確認し、指定日変更や取消しの可否をご案内します。金曜の入金はここでは確約しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the current reservation on the official screen and explain whether the date can be changed or the transfer canceled. We can't guarantee receipt on Friday here.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。先方へ金曜に必ず届くとは約束せず、確認が済んでから候補日を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金曜入金を確約せず確認後に先方へ日程を相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. I won't promise the recipient it will definitely arrive Friday; I'll discuss possible dates after the check.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you won't guarantee Friday receipt and will discuss dates with the recipient after checking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受取人と金額も元の予約どおりでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Should the recipient and amount stay as in the original reservation?

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、受取人と金額は変えず日付だけの相談です。変更が完了したかどうかも最後に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取人と金額は同じで日付のみ変更相談と完了状態確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, neither changes; I'm only asking about the date. I'd also like to confirm at the end whether a change has actually been completed.
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say recipient and amount remain the same, only the date is in question, and you want to confirm completion status. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。その一件の状態から確認しますので、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IWT-MIYAKO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll start by checking that one transfer's status. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は下の枝から始めます。この見本と実の色を比べてみてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today we'll start with the lower branches. Compare the fruit's color with this sample.

DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見本に近い色の実が上の枝にありますが、背伸びして取ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見本に近い高い枝の実を背伸びして取ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's fruit near the sample color on a higher branch. May I stretch up to pick it?
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may stretch up to pick high-branch fruit close to the sample color. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 高いところは別の担当が扱います。今日は足を地面に付けたまま届く実だけを見ましょう。
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Another person handles high areas. Today let's look only at fruit you can reach with your feet on the ground.

DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上の実は残します。下にあるこの実は色が少し薄いのですが、取る対象ですか。
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 高い実を残し下の薄い色の実が収穫対象か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll leave the high fruit. This lower fruit is a little paler; should it be picked?
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Leave the high fruit and ask whether the pale lower fruit should be harvested. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その実はまだ残してください。取る前に迷ったものは、こちらへ声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please leave that fruit for now. If you're unsure, call me before picking.

DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 色だけで決めず、迷った実を指して確認します。収穫ばさみの向きも見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 色で迷う実は指して確認しはさみの向きを見せてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than decide from color alone, I'll point out uncertain fruit and check. Could you also show how to orient the harvesting scissors?
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will point out uncertain-colored fruit for confirmation and ask to see the scissors' orientation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ええ、手元で示します。実を支える手と刃の位置を見てください。実を取った後はどこに置きますか。
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, I'll demonstrate up close. Watch the supporting hand and blade position. Where will you put the fruit after picking it?

DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の足元に箱を置こうと思っていましたが、通る人の邪魔になりませんか。
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 足元の箱が通行を妨げないか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was going to put a box by my feet, but wouldn't it get in the way of people passing?
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether a box by your feet would obstruct people. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 箱は通路の外のこの場所に置きましょう。いっぱいになる前に運ぶ係へ知らせてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's put the box here, outside the passage. Tell the transport worker before it becomes full.

DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 箱を指定の場所に置き、届く範囲の実を確認しながら取ります。量が増えたら運ぶ係を呼びます。
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定場所に箱を置き届く実を確認して量が増えたら運搬係を呼ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put it in the designated place and pick reachable fruit while checking. When the quantity increases, I'll call the transport worker.
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will place the box as designated, check reachable fruit, and call the transport worker as the load grows. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、最初の実を一緒に見てから始めましょう。今日の収穫、よろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-KCH-AKI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's examine the first fruit together before starting. Thank you for helping with today's harvest.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その木の道具が気になりますか。説明板はご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you interested in that wooden tool? Have you read the information panel?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 読みましたが、何に使う道具か分かりません。家族に説明できるよう、使い方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族に説明するため読んでも分からない道具の使い道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I read it, but don't understand what the tool is for. Please explain its use so I can tell my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the tool's use, which you didn't understand from reading, so you can explain to family. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この展示では、手で回して穀物を扱う道具として紹介しています。実物を動かすことはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This exhibit introduces it as a hand-turned tool for processing grain. The actual object cannot be operated.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 触らずに見ます。全体の形を写真に残したいのですが、この展示は撮影できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 実物を動かさず全体の形を写真に残せるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll look without touching. I'd like a photo of its overall shape. Is photography allowed for this exhibit?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may photograph the overall shape without operating the actual object. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 撮影の表示を一緒に見ましょう。ここは全体の撮影と、細部の撮影で案内が分かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the photography signs together. Instructions here differ for overall and detailed photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 全体の写真についての表示は読めますが、細部のほうはよく分かりません。近寄って撮る前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 全体と細部の表示を区別し近接撮影前に細部の案内を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can read the overall-photo sign but don't quite understand the details one. I'd like to check before moving closer to photograph.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish overall and detail-photo signs and ask about detail instructions before close-up photography. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 細部については担当に確認します。その間、説明板の言葉を書き留めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check details with the staff. Meanwhile, would you like to note words from the information panel?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 道具の名前と、穀物を扱うという説明をメモします。回す部分の名前も聞いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 道具名と穀物の説明を書き回す部分の名前を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll note the tool's name and the explanation about handling grain. May I also ask the name of the turning part?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Note the tool name and grain explanation and ask the turning part's name. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 名前は展示資料で確かめてお伝えします。ご家族にはどのように紹介しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check its name in the exhibit materials and tell you. How will you introduce it to your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前が分かったら、手で回す道具だとメモと一緒に伝えます。写真は確認できた範囲だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確かめた名前と説明を家族に伝え許可が分かる範囲だけ撮る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Once I know the name, I'll tell them it's a hand-turned tool and use my notes. I'll take photos only within the scope confirmed as allowed.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell family the checked name and explanation and photograph only what is confirmed permitted. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、資料を確かめますね。ほかの展示もゆっくりご覧ください。よい見学を。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll check the materials. Please take your time with the other exhibits too. Enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: このホームからの乗車ですか。お持ちのメモと表示を見比べていらっしゃいますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you boarding from this platform? I see you're comparing your notes with the display.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人のメモには途中で乗り換えるとあります。同じホームの列車なら、どれでもよいのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: メモの乗換があり同一ホームのどの列車でもよいか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend's notes say to change along the way. I'm unsure whether any train on the same platform will do.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether any train at the same platform works when your notes include a transfer. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じホームでも行先は異なります。目的の乗換駅が停車駅に含まれるか確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Trains at the same platform can have different destinations. Let's check whether your intended transfer station is among the stops.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ホームの番号だけを見ていました。停車駅の案内で、メモの乗換駅を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号だけを見ていたと認めメモの乗換駅を停車案内で探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was only looking at the platform number. I'll look for the noted transfer station in the stop information.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Admit looking only at the number and search the stop information for the transfer station in your notes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見つかったら、列車名も合わせて確認してください。同行の方はもうおそろいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Once found, check the train name too. Is everyone in your party here yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人は飲み物を買いに行っています。二人分の荷物を持っているので、先に乗るのは難しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飲み物を買う友人の荷物も持ち先に乗れないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend went to buy drinks. I have luggage for both of us, so boarding ahead would be difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you hold your drink-buying friend's luggage too and can't board ahead. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご友人が戻ってから一緒に案内を確認するとよいですね。待合せ場所は伝えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: It would be good to check the information together when your friend returns. Have you told them where to meet?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ホームの真ん中とだけ伝えました。今いる案内板の前に変更して連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 曖昧な中央という指定を案内板の前へ変更して友人に連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I only said the middle of the platform. I'll contact them and change it to in front of the information board where I am now.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Replace the vague middle-of-platform meeting place with the information board and tell your friend. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 目印があれば見つけやすいですね。列車が来ても判断できないときは、どうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: A landmark should help them find you. What will you do if a train arrives and you still can't tell?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 行先と停車駅が分からないまま乗らず、友人とメモを見せて係の方に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 行先が未確認なら乗らず友人とメモを示して係に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't board without knowing its destination and stops. My friend and I will show our notes and ask a staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you won't board with an unconfirmed destination and will show the notes with your friend to staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、確認してからご乗車ください。荷物にも気を付けて、よいご旅行を。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please check before boarding. Take care of your luggage, and have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 掲示をご覧ください。今は運転を見合わせており、再開の時刻は決まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please look at the notice. Service is suspended, and no restart time has been decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 山の上で景色を見たかったのですが、帰りの予定があります。待てばすぐ乗れるという意味ではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰りの予定があり待てばすぐ乗れるとは限らないと聞き返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wanted to see the scenery from the mountaintop, but have return plans. This doesn't mean I can ride soon just by waiting, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you have return plans and confirm waiting won't necessarily let you board soon. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ええ、再開をお約束する案内ではありません。何時までこの場所にいられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Correct; this information doesn't promise a restart. Until what time can you stay here?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あと三十分ほどです。その間に再開するか分からないなら、今日は上がらないことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三十分しかなく再開未定のため今日は乗らないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: About thirty more minutes. If it's unknown whether service resumes then, I won't go up today.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide not to ride today because only thirty minutes remain and restart is uncertain. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。同行される方にも予定の変更を伝えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Can you also tell your companion about the change of plan?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人が駐車場で待っています。山の上で会うつもりだったので、こちらへ来ずに待ってもらうと知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駐車場の友人には乗り場へ来ず待ってもらうと連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend is waiting in the parking lot. We planned to meet on the mountain, so I'll tell them to stay there rather than come here.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell the friend in the parking lot to wait rather than come to the boarding point. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 連絡してから合流するとよいですね。ここで必要な確認は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: It would be good to contact them before meeting. Is there anything else you need to check here?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ切符は買っていません。購入の相談ではなく、次回来る前に運転情報を調べる方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 切符は未購入で次回来る前の運転情報確認方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't bought a ticket yet. Rather than discuss a purchase, I'd like to know how to check service information before my next visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say no ticket has been bought and ask how to check service before the next visit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 運転案内の問い合わせ先を掲示で確認しましょう。天候だけで運転すると決めつけないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the service inquiry contact on the notice. Please don't assume it is running based on weather alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 問い合わせ先を控えます。次回は出発前に案内を確認し、今日は友人と別の予定に変えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 問い合わせ先を控え出発前に確認し今日は友人と予定を変える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note the contact. Next time I'll check before leaving; today I'll make different plans with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note the contact, plan to check before departure, and change today's plans with your friend. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、掲示を見てからお帰りください。次の機会をお待ちしています。合流の道中もお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please read the notice before leaving. We look forward to another opportunity. Take care on your way to meet your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 追加する金額を考えていらっしゃいますね。今回は何人で移動されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're considering how much to add to your card. How many people are traveling this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人です。私のカード一枚に二人分を足せば、友人の分も払えると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人分を一枚のカードへの追加で払えると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two. I thought adding enough for two to my one card would let me pay for my friend too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain thinking one card topped up for two could pay for both. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その使い方ができるかは、利用する交通機関の案内を確かめる必要があります。区間のメモはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Whether that's possible needs checking in the transport operator's instructions. Do you have notes on the route?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 往復の区間を書いてあります。まず、一枚で二人分を扱えるか、メモの区間について尋ねたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 往復メモを示し一枚で二人分を払えるか確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've written the outward and return sections. First I'd like to ask whether one card can cover two people on those sections.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show round-trip notes and ask whether one card can pay for two. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 往路と復路が同じ条件かも確認しましょう。ご友人は別のカードをお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's also check whether outward and return trips have the same conditions. Does your friend have another card?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人は持っていません。使えない場合に備えて、別に切符を買う方法も一緒に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人にカードがなく切符購入の方法も聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I'd also like to learn how to buy a separate ticket in case the card can't be used that way.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your friend has no card and ask how to buy a ticket too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 支払い方法を確認してから追加額を考えるとよいですね。今の残高は確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's best to check payment methods before deciding the top-up amount. Have you checked the current balance?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 残高の表示はまだ見ていません。二人分を足す前に、自分の残高と区間の利用案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残高未確認と認め追加前に自分の残高と区間案内を調べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't looked at the balance display yet. Before adding money for two, I'll check my balance and the route's usage instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Admit the balance is unchecked and check your balance and route instructions before topping up. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な条件が分かるまで追加は待ちましょう。確認したことはご友人にも共有されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's wait to top up until the necessary conditions are known. Will you also share what you check with your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。往復それぞれの支払い方法をメモして友人に伝え、二人分を同じ方法だと決めつけないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 往復別の方法をメモして共有し二人同一の方法と決めつけない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll note payment methods for the outward and return trips separately and tell my friend, without assuming the same method works for both people.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note and share outward and return payment methods and don't assume both people use the same method. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、区間の案内から見ていきましょう。お二人とも、移動の際はお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's begin with the route instructions. Both of you, take care while traveling.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 体験のお申込みですね。今日はどの案内を見ていらっしゃいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're applying for an activity, correct? Which information did you read before coming today?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初心者向けだと思って申し込みましたが、画面には動きの多い体験とあります。今日は疲れているので内容を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初心者向けと思ったが動きの多い体験で疲れがあり確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I applied thinking it was for beginners, but the screen says it's an activity with lots of movement. I'm tired today and want to check the content.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought it was for beginners but it involves much movement and you're tired, so you want to check. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内を読み直しましょう。体調についてこちらだけで参加の可否は判断できません。持参した靴も見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's reread the information. This desk alone cannot judge whether your condition allows participation. Could you also show the shoes you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 外を歩いてきた靴しかありません。施設内で使える靴か、確認せずに来てしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外を歩いた靴しかなく施設内で使えるか未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only have the shoes I walked here in. I came without checking whether they can be used inside the facility.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you only have outdoor-worn shoes and haven't checked whether they can be used indoors. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 履物の条件は体験の案内で確認します。いきなり参加せず、担当の説明を聞くことを希望されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check footwear conditions in the activity instructions. Would you prefer staff explanations before jumping into participation?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。運動を始める前に説明を聞きたいです。見学に変更できるかも担当に尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 運動前に説明を聞き見学への変更可否を担当に尋ねてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'd like the explanation before beginning exercise. Please also ask the staff whether I can change to observing.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for explanations before exercise and for staff to check whether you can switch to observation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更できるか確かめます。予約の画面にはどの体験名が表示されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check whether a change is possible. Which activity name appears on your booking screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この名前です。似た名前のゆっくりした体験と取り違えたようなので、二つの違いを教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約画面を示しゆっくりした体験と取り違えた可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: This name. I seem to have confused it with a slower activity with a similar name, so I'd like to know the difference.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the booking screen and explain you may have confused it with a slower activity. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から内容を説明します。説明を聞いてから今日はどうするか決められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will explain the content. After hearing it, you can decide what to do today.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 靴の条件と内容を聞くまでは参加しません。疲れもあるので、今日は見学の相談を先にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 靴と内容の確認前には参加せず疲れも踏まえ見学相談を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't participate until I hear the shoe requirements and content. Since I'm tired too, I'll prioritize asking about observing today.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Don't participate before checking shoes and content, and prioritize observation advice considering your fatigue. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。担当が来るまでこちらでお待ちください。お帰りも無理をせず、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait here until the staff comes. Take it easy on your way home too, and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 席をお探しですか。前のほうには水がかかることを示す案内があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a seat? The signs at the front indicate that water may splash there.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 近くで見たかったのですが、鞄に紙の資料が入っています。ぬれる可能性があるなら席を変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紙の資料があり水がかかる可能性なら前列を避けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wanted a close view, but have paper documents in my bag. If they might get wet, I'd like to change seats.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have paper documents and want to avoid the front rows if water may splash. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内のある範囲から離れた席を探しましょう。見やすさについて、ご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's find a seat away from the marked area. Do you have preferences about the view?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前の人の頭で見えにくくならない場所がよいです。ただ、席から立って見るつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 頭で見えにくくない席を希望し立って見るつもりはないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Somewhere my view isn't blocked by the head in front. But I don't intend to stand up from my seat to watch.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a seat without head-obstructed views and say you won't stand to watch. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 空いている席の位置を一緒に見ましょう。同行の方と並んで座りたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the available seats together. Would you like to sit beside your companion?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人で来ています。空席でも荷物だけで隣を取らず、鞄は自分の足元に置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人で隣席を荷物で確保せず自分の足元に置くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm alone. I won't reserve the empty seat beside me just with luggage; I'll put my bag at my own feet.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you're alone and will put your bag at your feet rather than occupy an adjacent seat with it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路をふさがない位置にしてください。撮影の案内もまだ確認されていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep it out of the passage. Have you checked the photography instructions yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。録画したいと思っていましたが、座る前に演目の撮影案内を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 録画希望はあるが座る前に演目の案内を読むと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I wanted to record video, but I'll read this show's photography instructions before sitting down.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to record video but will read the show's instructions before sitting. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 演目ごとの案内を見て、分からない点は聞いてください。今選ぶ席は決まりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the instructions for each show and ask about anything unclear. Have you chosen your seat now?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 水の案内から離れたこの席にします。撮影できると分かるまでは、カメラを出さずに見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 水の案内から離れた席を選び撮影可否が判明するまでカメラを出さない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take this seat away from the water warning. Until I know photography is allowed, I'll watch without taking out my camera.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a seat away from the water warning and keep the camera away until permission is known. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、荷物を確かめてお座りください。席からゆっくり、よい観覧を。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then check your belongings and have a seat. Enjoy watching comfortably from your seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 荷物のお受け取りの相談ですね。票の受取人名を読んでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about collecting a parcel. Could you read the recipient name on the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 名字は同じですが、名前は姉です。自分の荷物だと思って持ってきてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 名字は同じだが姉宛ての票を自分のものと取り違えたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The surname is the same, but the given name is my older sister's. I brought it thinking it was my parcel.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you mistook your sister's notice for yours because the surname matches. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご家族宛てなのですね。お姉さまから受け取りについて何か頼まれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's addressed to a family member, then. Has your sister asked you to collect it?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ頼まれていません。同じ住所なら私が受け取れると考えていましたが、先に姉に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 依頼されておらず同住所だけで受け取れると決めず姉に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I assumed I could because we share an address, but I'll check with my sister first.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you weren't asked and will check with your sister rather than assume a shared address permits collection. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受取りの条件は荷物と方法によって確認が必要です。票の案内はどこまで読みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Collection conditions depend on the parcel and method and need checking. How much of the notice's instructions have you read?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 連絡先だけ見ました。代理で受け取る場合の案内があるか、番号の近くの記載も読んでみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 連絡先だけでなく代理受取りの案内も探して読むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only the contact information. I'll also read the wording near the number to see whether there are instructions for collecting on someone else's behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll read proxy-collection instructions too, not only the contact details. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分からないところは一緒に確認しましょう。ご自身にも届く予定の荷物がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check unclear parts together. Are you also expecting a parcel yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。注文の画面を見直し、自分の荷物の番号とこの票の番号を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の注文画面と姉の不在票の番号を別々に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll review my order screen and check my parcel number separately from this notice's number.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check your own order-screen number and your sister's missed-delivery notice number separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 取り違えないよう整理できますね。お姉さまへは何を伝えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That should avoid a mix-up. What will you tell your sister?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 姉宛ての票があることを知らせ、希望する受取方法を聞きます。その返答と票をそろえて条件を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 姉に票と受取り希望を尋ね返答と票をそろえて条件を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell her there's a notice addressed to her and ask how she'd like to receive it. I'll bring her answer and the notice together to discuss the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell your sister about the notice, ask her preferred receiving method, and bring the answer and notice to discuss conditions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、宛名と案内を確かめてからお進めください。ご家族との確認が済んだらまたどうぞ。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-AKI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then check the recipient and instructions before proceeding. Please return once you've checked with your family. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は収穫の補助をお願いします。入る前に、担当する列を見ておきましょう。
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please help with harvesting today. Before entering, let's check your assigned row.

DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入口から見て右の列でしょうか。赤い札と黄色い札があるので、どちらか分かりません。
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 赤と黄色の札があり担当列を判断できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is it the right-hand row as seen from the entrance? There are red and yellow tags, so I'm unsure which.
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you can't identify the assigned row because there are red and yellow tags. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日お願いするのは黄色い札の列です。赤い札の列には入らず、こちらで見本を見てください。
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today it's the yellow-tagged row. Don't enter the red-tagged row; look at the sample here.

DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 黄色い札の列だけですね。収穫するものと残すものの違いを、実物で見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 黄色の列と確認し収穫するものと残すものの実物を見たいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only the yellow-tagged row, right? Could you show actual examples of what to harvest and what to leave?
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the yellow row and ask to see actual harvest and leave examples. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最初は私と一緒に見て判断しましょう。道具はもう受け取りましたか。
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's look and decide together at first. Have you received your tools yet?

DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このかごを受け取りましたが、はさみはまだです。手で取ってよいのかも教わっていません。
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: かごだけ受け取りはさみと取り方をまだ教わっていないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've received this basket but not scissors. I haven't been taught whether picking by hand is allowed either.
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you only received the basket and haven't yet been taught about scissors or picking technique. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 使う道具と取り方は、ここで説明してから渡します。分からないものは取らずに私を呼んでください。
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll explain the tools and technique here before handing them over. If you're unsure about anything, leave it and call me.

DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 途中で札が見えなくなった場合も、作業を止めて確認してよいですか。
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 札が見えなくなったら止めて尋ねてよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I lose sight of the tag during the work, may I stop and check too?
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether you may stop and ask if the tag is no longer visible. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 札の位置を見失ったら声をかけてください。かごを置く場所も、先に一緒に確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please call me if you lose track of the tag. Let's also check where to put the basket first.

DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず道具の説明を聞き、黄色い札の列で一緒に見分けます。札や野菜で迷ったらお呼びします。
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 道具の説明と対象の見分けを済ませ迷ったら呼ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I'll hear the tool explanation and identify the produce together in the yellow row. I'll call you if I'm unsure about tags or vegetables.
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will learn the tools and identify the target produce first, then call if unsure. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その進め方でお願いします。見本のところへ移動しましょう。説明が済んだら担当の列でまた合流します。
DLG-SC-KCH-NANKOKU-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed that way. Let's go to the sample. After the explanation, we'll meet again at your assigned row.
